research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Plume Design is researching computerized systems and methods for an energy aware adaptive network and energy management in Wi Fi networks and smart homes that optimize connected home performance. Work such as systems and methods for an adaptive smart mesh topology and optimization of distributed Wi Fi networks focuses on cloud based control, multi link operation and automated modification of wireless networks. Additional efforts address home security via a Wi Fi network and Wi Fi network based interactive gaming. Overall, Plume develops adaptive networking, security, energy and interactive services.

overview_description.description:
Plume is a software-as-a-service platform for communications service providers (CSPs) that enables the delivery of services for connected homes. Its platform serves connected homes, delivering features like optimum Wi-Fi, parental controls, and motion sensing to smart home residents while giving communication service providers back-end applications to provide support.

Founded in 2015, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Plume is a SaaS platform that provides the delivery of technological services for connected homes.

product.name: Plume Platform
product.description: A cloud-based, AI-enabled platform that helps internet service providers manage networks, deliver connected-home and business services, and support subscribers across the customer lifecycle.

product.name: Plume Home
product.description: A residential broadband service platform for managed Wi-Fi, connected-home security, device control, and home network performance management.

product.name: Haystack
product.description: A network visibility and operations platform that detects subscriber connectivity issues, supports troubleshooting, and automates workflows for proactive resolution.

product.name: WorkPass
product.description: A managed connectivity platform for small businesses that provides wireless networking, productivity features, security controls, and business network insights.

product.name: Uprise
product.description: A managed Wi-Fi and network platform for multi-dwelling properties, enabling property owners and service providers to oversee tenant, property, and common-area connectivity.

product.name: Sweepr
product.description: An AI-orchestrated customer experience platform that converts network intelligence into guided and automated support actions across digital and service channels.
